{{Top|leg}}
'''Indoctrination droids''' were used by the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] to help train [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] recruits. They presented lectures detailed the glory of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], and made suggestions to individual recruits as to how they could change their attitude to be a better servant of the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]].
